articles.title: Rules Hub
articles.text:
Below is a collection of Riftbound’s latest rules documents. If you’re ever curious about Riftbounds current rules, regulations, systems and practices, let the below documents be your guide.

Are you wanting to learn Riftbound? Go here instead. The below documents are useful in the way that a car manual is useful when you’re learning to drive. Which is to say, it is useful for some, but probably not yet useful for others.

Constructed Format Legality

Last updated: September 18, 2026

All sets currently produced for Riftbound are legal to be played in sanctioned tournaments at your local game store as well as at larger tournaments. Starting in 2028, we intend to introduce rotation of legal sets for play in Standard Constructed (our primary constructed format.)

The following are banned from play in sanctioned Constructed tournaments:



Cards

Called Shot

Ekko, Recurrent

Draven, Vanquisher

Fight or Flight

Scrapheap

Stealthy Pursuer

Stacked Deck

Battlefields

The Arena’s Greatest

Aspirant’s Climb

Dreaming Tree

Obelisk of Power

Reaver’s Row

2v2 Constructed Legality

Last updated: September 18, 2026

As above, all sets currently produced for Riftbound are legal to be played in sanctioned tournaments.



Legends

Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman

Cards

Called Shot

Ekko, Recurrent

Draven Vanquisher

Fight or Flight

Scrapheap

Stealthy Pursuer

Stacked Deck

Battlefields

The Arena’s Greatest

Aspirant’s Climb

Dreaming Tree

Obelisk of Power

Reaver’s Row

Core Rules

The Core Rules are the engine that drives a Riftbound game. This document covers deckbuilding rules, timing and resolution of cards and abilities, order of effects, and all the other little rules that define the flow of a game.

Core Rules (last updated: October 9, 2026)

Tournament Rules

The Tournament Rules outline the guidelines for running Riftbound tournaments and deckbuilding guidelines to the Riftbound experience that occur when taking part in an official event.

The Tournament Rules also provide additional guidance for running tournaments and adjudicating issues that arise during play.

Tournament Rules (last updated: October 9, 2026)

Patch Notes

Patch Note articles answer questions and explain the rules and interactions you’ll commonly encounter.

Core Rules Patch Notes

Spiritforged Patch Notes

Unleashed Patch Notes

Vendetta Patch Notes

Radiance Patch Notes

Errata

With new sets, we issue updates to the rules text on Riftbound cards, called ‘errata.’ Here are the past updates to the rules text for the printed cards.

Origins Errata

Spiritforged Errata

Unleashed Errata

Vendetta Errata

Radiance Errata

Judges

Are you interested in becoming a Riftbound judge and helping grow the Riftbound community? Judges are one of the backbones of a TCG community helping run events at store and Regional levels.

Take UVS’s judge test and get certified!

articles.title: Riftbound’s 2026 Drawings
articles.text:
We’re about to wrap up 2026, which comes with three new products for Riftbound. Here’s everything you need to know about each bundle and how to buy them.

Important note: some of these products will be available at in-person events! Check the “Purchase Details” sections for more info. (If there are more details to share closer to each event, the Riftbound social channels will announce them.)

[IMAGE: visual review required]

Riftbound x K/DA Couture Collection

The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection pulls back the curtain on a new stage for K/DA—the tabletop. Unbox collectible Legends and a Battlefield celebrating the FIRESTARTER era, complete with all-new artwork by Fortiche.

Contents

4 collectible Legend cards, featuring brand-new K/DA artwork.

Agony’s Embrace (Evelynn), Nine-Tailed Fox (Ahri), Rogue Assassin (Akali), Daughter of the Void (Kai’Sa).

1 collectible Battlefield card.

Packed Amphitheater.

1 K/DA Limited Edition Playmat.

1 K/DA Limited Edition Deck Box.

1 pack of K/DA Limited Edition Card Sleeves.

4 K/DA Limited Edition D12 Metal Dice.

1 FIRESTARTER KiT Keychain and User Manual.

The K/DA - FIRESTARTER KiT Keychain can be connected to your phone to play K/DA’s newest single and official music video.

Cost: $150.00 + shipping and handling.

Languages: English and Chinese.

Purchase Details

The Riftbound x K/DA Couture Collection will be available via online drawing, where you can enter for the chance to purchase it from the Riot Games Merch store. If you are selected from drawing, you’ll be notified via email, and you’ll have a 24-hour window to complete your purchase.

Drawing registration opens: October 27, 9:00 AM PT

Drawing registration closes: October 30, 9:00 AM PT

Emails to first round of selectees: November 3

Fulfillment of online purchases will begin within 1-3 business days after orders are placed.

The Riftbound x K/DA Couture Collection will also be available to purchase on-site at Convergence Fest, December 11-13.

T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle

The League of Legends World Championship has just begun, and we’ve got new esports-themed bundles to celebrate.

The T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle honors the 2025 winners with Champion cards chosen by Doran, Oner, Faker, Gumayusi, and Keria. (These are the same cards as in the T1 2025 Worlds Champion Signature Edition, with different Alt Arts.) Play or collect them—with limited-edition accessories—and celebrate their place in League history.

[IMAGE: visual review required]

Contents

5 collectible Champion cards, featuring official T1 Worlds 2025 skin splash art.

Ambessa The Wolf, Xin Zhao The Vigilant, Galio Indefatigable, Miss Fortune Buccaneer, and Seraphine Not Alone.

1 T1 Worlds Champion Deck Box.

1 T1 Worlds Champion Card Binder.

1 pack of T1 Worlds Champion Card Sleeves.

1 T1 Worlds Champion D12 Dice.

Each bundle has a chance to contain a rare gold dice variant.

Cost: $70.00 + shipping and handling.

Languages: English, Chinese, Korean.

Purchase Details

The T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle will be available at on-site merch stores for Worlds Quarterfinals (Allen, Texas), Semifinals (Allen, Texas), and Worlds Fan Fest (New York City, New York) throughout November.

It will also be available via online drawing. Enter for the chance to purchase it from the Riot Games Merch store. If you are selected from drawing, you’ll be notified via email, and you’ll have a 24-hour window to complete your purchase.

Drawing registration opens: November 13, 9:00 AM PT

Drawing registration closes: November 16, 9:00 AM PT

Emails to first round of selectees: November 17

Fulfillment of purchases will begin in mid-December.

Riftbound x Worlds 2026 Edition

All things League collide in the Riftbound x Worlds 2026 Edition. Celebrate the peak of League of Legends competition with an Alt Art Yasuo promo card, 3 Battlefield promo cards with custom art of each North American host city, and Worlds-themed accessories.

[IMAGE: visual review required]

Contents

1 collectible Legend promo card, featuring new art exclusively for Worlds.

Unforgiven (Yasuo).

3 collectible Battlefield promo cards, featuring art of each Worlds 2026 host city.

Los Angeles, Allen, and New York City.

1 Worlds 2026 Deck Box.

1 pack of Worlds 2026 Foil Card Sleeves.

Cost: $80.00 + shipping and handling.

Languages: English.

Purchase Details

The Riftbound x Worlds 2026 Edition will be available at on-site merch stores for Worlds Quarterfinals (Allen, Texas), Semifinals (Allen, Texas), and Worlds Fan Fest (New York City, New York) throughout November.

The Worlds 2026 Edition will also be available via online drawing. When purchased online, it will include the Worlds Unvaulted Capsule 2026, an in-game item redeemable in League of Legends.

When the online drawing opens, enter for the chance to purchase from the Riot Games Merch store. If you are selected from drawing, you’ll be notified via email, and you’ll have a 24-hour window to complete your purchase.

Drawing registration opens: November 13, 9:00 AM PT

Drawing registration closes: November 16, 9:00 AM PT

Emails to first round of selectees: November 17

Fulfillment of online purchases will begin in mid-December.

Gift of the Rift Bundle

The Gift of the Rift Bundle celebrates the first year of Riftbound in style! It includes Booster Packs from Riftbound’s first five sets, seasonal accessories, and an Alt Art Akali promo card, exclusive to the English version.

[IMAGE: visual review required]

Contents

16 Booster Packs.

3 Origins, 3 Spiritforged, 3 Unleashed, 3 Vendetta, and 4 Radiance Booster Packs.

36 Runes, featuring a foil treatment.

6 Order, 6 Chaos, 6 Fury, 6 Calm, 6 Mind, and 6 Body.

1 collectible Legend promo card.

Rogue Assassin (Akali), exclusive to the English version.

1 pack of Akali Card Sleeves.

Featuring art from the Akali promo card, exclusive to the English version.

1 Card Storage Box.

Holds 2000 cards.

Cost: $109

Languages: English (with exclusive Akali promo), Chinese (with exclusive Kennen promo).

Purchase Details

This product will be sold via your Local Game Store and other retailers. It’ll be available starting December 4, just in time for the holidays!

[IMAGE: visual review required]

articles.title: Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection Drawing FAQ
articles.text:
The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection Drawing 

The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection drawings have arrived! The FIRESTARTER era shines in this premium bundle.

Important Details

Contents: The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection pulls back the curtain on a new stage for K/DA—the tabletop. Unbox everything below, complete with all-new artwork by Fortiche.

4 collectible Legend cards, featuring brand-new K/DA artwork

Agony’s Embrace (Evelynn), Nine-Tailed Fox (Ahri), Rogue Assassin (Akali), Daughter of the Void (Kai’Sa)

1 collectible Battlefield card

Packed Amphitheater

1 K/DA Limited Edition Playmat

1 K/DA Limited Edition Deck Box

1 pack of K/DA Limited Edition Card Sleeves 

75 sleeves

4 K/DA Limited Edition D12 Metal Dice

1 FIRESTARTER KiT Keychain and User Manual

The K/DA - FIRESTARTER KiT Keychain can be connected to your phone to play K/DA’s newest single and official music video.

Cost: This product will be priced at $150.00 + shipping and handling.


How does the drawing work?


Registration goes live on October 27 at 9:00 AM PT, and closes October 30 at 9:00 AM PT. If you are chosen, you will be notified via email beginning on November 3. You’ll have a 24-hour window to complete your purchase, and product shipping will begin shortly after orders are completed.


What’s the schedule for the drawing?




Drawing registration opens: October 27, 9:00 AM PT

Drawing registration closes: October 30, 9:00 AM PT

Emails to first round of selectees: November 3


If I complete my purchase, when will my order be fulfilled?




We expect to begin fulfilling orders within 1-3 business days after they’re placed.

(Fulfillment includes processing, packaging, and shipping orders. It doesn’t represent an expected delivery date or shipping speed.)


The Drawing Experience 

Riftbound uses a drawing system for purchasing certain products from the Riot Merch Store. Here’s the details:

During the registration window, you can throw your name in the ring for the opportunity to purchase product.

If your name is drawn, you’ll be sent a link to purchase a few days later via email. If you would like to purchase the products you selected, you’ll have a 24-hour window to do so. 

The selection process is entirely random, with multiple layers to check that the chosen account is real and not fraudulent.

If you decide not to purchase, or the time window expires and you haven’t completed your purchase, someone new will be drawn and notified.

Players should ensure that riotgames.com emails are not being marked as spam or filtered into the trash.

Players should check that they have access to their account prior to the sign up period for the drawing. If not they can visit Riot’s recovery platform or submit a ticket to player support.


What happens if my name is drawn?


If your name is chosen in the drawing, you’ll be sent a link to a shopping cart with the products that your name was drawn for. The link to purchase will work for 24 hours. If you choose not to purchase, we will move on to the next person, chosen at random. 


What if I’m selected for multiple products?


You are able to remove items from your shopping cart if you do not wish to purchase all products which you were drawn for. Removing an item from your cart is final and cannot be undone.


What happens if someone is drawn but doesn’t purchase their product?


If a player is chosen to purchase one or more products but decides not to, that player’s chance at the bundle will be done as soon as their purchase window expires. 

Once a player’s purchase window expires, the stock will be returned to the store and the system will do a new drawing for the product that was not purchased. This drawing will only be drawn from among people who have not yet been selected for those products. These waves will continue until the stock on the Riot Merch store is depleted.


How do I receive product?


Once you’ve purchased the items you drew, they will begin fulfillment the day of the product’s wide release. 


How do I provide feedback or get help with any issues?


If you have feedback or run into issues or have questions, reach out to our Player Support team.
